headline: Sanjay D’Souza superannuates as Group Head and Senior Management Personnel
why: Key SME business head retired after 27 years; notable departure of senior leadership.

people.name: Sanjay D’Souza
people.role: Group Head – Business Banking, Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group and Senior Management Personnel
people.background: Associated with the Bank for nearly 27 years and was one of the key architects of the Bank’s SME business, contributing significantly across both Credit and Business.
